about_short_description.short_description: SolitAir Holding is a time-sensitive B2B middle-mile aircraft transportation company that offers regular schedules.

product.name: Pharmaceuticals Transport
product.description: Air cargo transport service specialized in handling pharmaceuticals with temperature control and regulatory compliance.

product.name: Frozen Goods Handling
product.description: Air cargo service for transporting frozen goods with cold chain maintenance using insulated containers and temperature monitoring.

product.name: Mail Transport
product.description: Air cargo service for timely and secure delivery of mail using standardized containers and pallets for organization and protection.

product.name: Oversized Freight Transport
product.description: Air cargo service for transporting oversized freight on all-cargo aircraft with specialized packaging to prevent damage.

product.name: Dangerous Goods Transport
product.description: Air cargo service for transporting all classes of dangerous goods except radioactive materials, following IATA safety regulations.

product.name: E-Commerce Cargo Handling
product.description: Air cargo service supporting e-commerce shipments with durable packaging, proper labeling, and real-time tracking.
